biography:
I help the world’s most ambitious data center and hyperscale solution providers solve their greatest challenge: combing access to clean, reliable, scalable power, with the ability to deliver tens and even hundreds of MW in around 90-180 days.

As leader for Bloom Energy’s data center practice in EMEA, I work at the intersection of digital infrastructure and the energy transition—partnering with colocation leaders, and the hyperscale community, to deliver sustainable power solutions that de-risk growth, accelerate decarbonisation and enable our partners to respond to the AI opportunity at warp speed.

With 25 years of experience across digital infrastructure, energy, and enterprise technology, I bring a track record of helping global enterprises scale while staying ahead of regulatory, environmental, and economic change. In building trusted partnerships, shaping long-term energy strategies, and ensuring customers can expand with confidence in a volatile energy landscape, Bloom Energy is game changing technology.
